title: KCF Source Trace v1
description: Maps each source-document segment to the model construct identities the extraction produced from it. Kept as a side artifact so the IR contract stays unchanged while every construct can still be traced to its originating prose.

documentVersion.description: Version of the source document this trace was built against.

assertions.description: Optional assertion-level trace records: how a specific proposition in this segment became a specific construct, and where it sits in the encoding-review lifecycle. Linkage (constructs) proves nothing was dropped/invented; these records carry the interpretation and its review state.

semanticIdentity.description: The construct identity this record is about (must appear in the link's constructs).

sourceExcerptHash.description: Hash of the exact source excerpt this was extracted from (tamper/version evidence).

extractedProposition.description: The proposition the extractor read from the excerpt, in words.

transformation.description: How the source text was transformed into the encoding - the interpretation applied.

reviewState.description: The encoding-review lifecycle: trace-linked (linked only) -> encoding-reviewed (a human checked the encoding) -> semantically-confirmed (a human confirmed it means the source); disputed/superseded are off-path.

reviewedAt.description: When the review happened (ISO 8601). Required for a confirmation to be governed.
